Happy Arbor Day! Arbor Day originated in Nebraska in 1872 when J. Sterling Morton proposed a special day for tree planting to the Nebraska Board of Agriculture. It’s one of my favorite Nebraska traditions.

Met with the Siouxland Chamber of Commerce in D.C. this week. We discussed several different issues that matter to their communities.

I shared how the ROAD to Housing Act helps addresses the demand for rural housing. We also discussed how the Working Families Tax Cuts expands Pell Grant eligibility to short-term job training for programs to grow our workforce. I also shared recent wins for healthcare like the extension of telehealth waivers for rural hospitals.

It’s always great to have Nebras

Renewable natural gas (RNG) from Nebraska fuels America! We’re home to the nation’s 500th RNG project.

I was glad to express my support for biofuels at the Renewable National Gas Coalition Summit this week. They’re a win-win-win for consumers, the environment, and farmers and ranchers!

I also discussed my Renewable Fuels for Ocean-Going Vessels Act which would expand biofuel use in maritime vessels.

Thank you for having me, @CoalitionForRNG!

As Nebraskans start to receive their tax refunds, working families are seeing how these historic tax cuts are putting more money in their pockets.

So far, Americans have received about $274 billion in total refunds. That’s $3,400 per person!

When I was Governor, I signed into law the elimination of state income taxes on Social Security. I’m doing more of the same in the Senate. 

Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts, 88% of American seniors no longer have to pay federal income taxes on Social Security. That’s about 265,000 Nebraska seniors who won’t have to pay any income taxes on their Social Security benefits.

It’s only been a week since Tax Day, and Nebraskans are already seeing more money in their pockets! 

When I visited La Casa Pizzeria in Omaha, a restaurant manager shared the story of a waitress whose wages were incorrectly reported. Once corrections were made, she received an extra $1,500 in her tax returns because of the no tax on overtime provision. The Working Families Tax Cuts are working for Nebraskans!

This outrageous incident reinforces that the UK can’t hand over the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, home to Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia. It is further proof they are susceptible to Communist China’s pressure.

The UK cannot put American security at risk.

Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts, Americans have already seen an 11% increase in average refunds compared to last year. CBS News reports that the average tax refund will increase by about $1,000 per filer. I’m looking forward to seeing more great results!
I am glad that justice is being served. I will continue the fight to protect Nebraska servicemembers and America’s security.

The threat of Communist China’s spying efforts on sensitive American military sites is real and persistent. I’ve made fighting against it my priority with bills like the AFIDA Improvements Act and the PLOT Act. These make sure foreign adversaries can’t own American agricultural land.

I want to thank and praise the security forces at Offutt Air Force Base and the FBI special agents in Omaha for their work on this case. Offutt is home to U.S. Strategic Command, as well as critical aircraft like the RC-135 and E-4B. It is one of the most sensitive military installations in the country.


KETV NewsWatch 7 (@KETV)

It’s always great to welcome Nebraska hospitals to our Nation’s Capital! I appreciated hearing feedback on the reforms we made to PBMs and how the Rural Health Transformation Program can improve to better serve our rural communities.

I look forward to continued partnership with the NE Hospital Association to provide quality care to Nebraskans.

Softball America has ranked @HuskerSoftball as the top team in the nation! Wishing them the best of luck as the season continues.

Meeting with Nebraskans while traveling our state is one of my favorite parts of this job.  I was able to visit Nebraska health care facilities.

The new Kimball Health Services facility is beautiful, with state-of-the-art tools to keep Nebraskans healthy. I also met with the dedicated healthcare workers at Blair’s Memorial Community Hospital.

At both facilities, we discussed how the Working Families Tax Cuts provides them with funding and support. More funds are available for healthcare, while

The Working Families Tax Cuts supports the next generation of Nebraska ag leaders. It extends the Beginning Farmers and Ranchers Development Benefit coverage from five years to ten years. That gives new producers a longer window to access to critical risk management tools.


Dept. of Agriculture (@USDA)

Meet Matt Cover.

He’s a proud first-generation rancher in Ashby, Nebraska. Matt is building a cattle herd while raising his family on the land he loves.

Congratulations to Jenilee Woltman of Hemingford for winning the Innovation Business of the Year award at the annual NBDC Business Awards. Jenilee is a mom, rancher, and entrepreneur.  Nebraskans are real community leaders!

Our ironclad alliance remains the bedrock of peace and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific.
